# newrelic_rpm

**Tag**: web, networking

## 简介

New Relic is a performance management system, developed by New Relic,
Inc (http://www.newrelic.com).  New Relic provides you with deep
information about the performance of your web application as it runs
in production. The New Relic Ruby agent is dual-purposed as a either a
Gem or plugin, hosted on
https://github.com/newrelic/newrelic-ruby-agent/

## 官网

- 主页: https://newrelic.com/ruby
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/newrelic/newrelic-ruby-agent
- 文档: https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/agents/ruby-agent
- 更新日志: https://github.com/newrelic/newrelic-ruby-agent/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/newrelic/newrelic-ruby-agent/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/newrelic_rpm
